  Readable gloss: "A verb centered on falsehood in speech and reality. The Nifal conveys being exposed as false, while the Hifil means to prove someone a liar. Strikingly, it can also describe things that 'lie' — streams that fail the thirsty traveler (Isa 58:11) — a metaphor the Arabic cognate kadhaba shares. Balaam's declaration that God is 'not a man that he should lie' (Num 23:19) anchors the word's theological weight."
